Bottom SheetContainment

The `m3e-bottom-sheet` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Basic usage

M3eelbuildHTML
[ M3e.button [] [ M3e.bottomSheetTrigger [ M3e.BottomSheetTrigger.for "bottomSheet" ] [ Kit.text "Open bottom sheet" ] ]
, M3e.bottomSheet [ M3e.Attributes.id "bottomSheet" ]
[ M3e.actionList []
[ M3e.listAction []
[ M3e.bottomSheetAction [] [ Kit.text "Google Keep" ]
, M3e.ListAction.supportingText (Kit.text "Add to a note")
]
, M3e.listAction []
[ M3e.bottomSheetAction [] [ Kit.text "Google Docs" ]
, M3e.ListAction.supportingText (Kit.text "Embed in a document")
]
]
]
]
[ M3e.Button.el
{ content = M3e.BottomSheetTrigger.view [ M3e.BottomSheetTrigger.for "bottomSheet" ] [ Kit.text "Open bottom sheet" ]
, action = M3e.Action.none
}
[]
[]
, M3e.BottomSheet.view [ M3e.Attributes.id "bottomSheet" ]
[ M3e.ActionList.view []
[ M3e.ListAction.view []
[ M3e.BottomSheetAction.view [] [ Kit.text "Google Keep" ]
, M3e.ListAction.supportingText (Kit.text "Add to a note")
]
, M3e.ListAction.view []
[ M3e.BottomSheetAction.view [] [ Kit.text "Google Docs" ]
, M3e.ListAction.supportingText (Kit.text "Embed in a document")
]
]
]
]
[ M3e.Button.build
{ content = M3e.BottomSheetTrigger.view [ M3e.BottomSheetTrigger.for "bottomSheet" ] [ Kit.text "Open bottom sheet" ]
, action = M3e.Action.none
}
|> M3e.Button.toElement
, M3e.BottomSheet.view [ M3e.Attributes.id "bottomSheet" ]
[ M3e.ActionList.build
|> M3e.ActionList.withChild
(M3e.ListAction.view []
[ M3e.BottomSheetAction.view [] [ Kit.text "Google Keep" ]
, M3e.ListAction.supportingText (Kit.text "Add to a note")
]
)
|> M3e.ActionList.withChild
(M3e.ListAction.view []
[ M3e.BottomSheetAction.view [] [ Kit.text "Google Docs" ]
, M3e.ListAction.supportingText (Kit.text "Embed in a document")
]
)
|> M3e.ActionList.toElement
]
]
<m3e-button>
<m3e-bottom-sheet-trigger for="bottomSheet"> Open bottom sheet </m3e-bottom-sheet-trigger>
</m3e-button>
<m3e-bottom-sheet id="bottomSheet">
<m3e-action-list>
<m3e-list-action>
<m3e-bottom-sheet-action>Google Keep</m3e-bottom-sheet-action>
<span slot="supporting-text">Add to a note</span>
</m3e-list-action>
<m3e-list-action>
<m3e-bottom-sheet-action>Google Docs</m3e-bottom-sheet-action>
<span slot="supporting-text">Embed in a document</span>
</m3e-list-action>
</m3e-action-list>
</m3e-bottom-sheet>

API

Constructor

view : List.List (HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr M3e.Component.BottomSheet.Attrs msg) -> List.List (HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts (M3e.Component.BottomSheet.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> HtmlIr.Element.Element (M3e.Component.BottomSheet.Is s) admittedBy msg

Standard constructor: [attributes] [children]. The default slot is kind-permissive (any): children of any kind compose, but each child's OWN admittedBy must still admit this context — a restricted-parent element is rejected here at compile time.

type Is

The kind row m3e-bottom-sheet produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

Place an element into the named header slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

Place a pre-built element into the default (unnamed) slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list). The list-form sibling of the builder's withChild.
